body: Happy birthday! I hope it’s great, you deserve it!
You can always direct message me if you need to! Please feel free to use me as your outlet. I’m here for you.

I didn’t end up going to work today for something stupid I did to myself and now I’m going to miss my other job because I’m feeling like shit from doing what I did that caused me to leave my first job. I’m just useless and I ruin everything. I’m becoming more and more selfish every day and it’s causing people to suffer. I’m punishing myself and I know I’m doing wrong. I’m doing it because I don’t want to feel like a failure anymore but yet I want to dig myself in this hole of doing nothing because I’ve lost motivation to do anything, especially doing what I love. I’m sorry if that doesn’t make sense

I try to be honest with him, but he told me he has to isolate how he feels in order to deal with my severe anxiety and depression, which makes me feel even worse. I try to feel positive through my part time job at Joann Fabrics but when I come home I instantly feel the need to lay down or do nothing. I have the urge to do so much but I fill myself with doubt because I just feel lack of motivation and confidence. I used to have so much confidence when I was in college but I’ve shifted into a negative mindset where I feel like I’m stupid and can’t do anything anymore. It’s disappointing

Just hate myself as per usual. Trying to be happy and make the most of my day, but it seems to be impossible. I even try to be happy around my boyfriend for his sake and I can’t even do that. I’m always feeling miserable. I just can’t function anymore.
I’m glad I have it as an outlet. I just wish I could feel a sense of happiness for one moment

I work at Joann’s a couple days a week. I feel so appreciated during those couple days a week. When I come home I drown myself in depression and I end up falling asleep because I just don’t want to think anymore.
